Author: TheKHD5
Name: Bestiary Nav
Description: Click a Bestiary entry to find its capture location or duty. Highlight nearby uncaptured beasts and optionally travel to them with Lifestream and vnavmesh. /bnav opens the Bestiary; /bnav config opens settings.
Changelog:
- Travel to spawn areas with mounts and flight.
- Underground routing for Ghost/Bogy (#40).
- Custom chat messages and channel selection.
- Three UI styles and seven color palettes.
- Resizable windows and separated title-bar controls.

Full details on GitHub repo:
